# pokeynoiseplugin

Atari XL/XE **POKEY** music in the PokeyNoise format, via **ASAP**.

Extensions: `.pn` (more often named `pn.<song>`)

## Build gating

**ChipMachinePlus only.** ASAP is not part of the Mac App Store build (see
[`LEGAL-PLUS`](../../../../../LEGAL-PLUS)) and those 17 songs are hidden there.

Atari 8-bit POKEY music is otherwise unaffected: the 6,617-song `.sap` ASMA
corpus plays through [gmeplugin](../gmeplugin/README.md) in **both** builds, and
16 of the 17 PokeyNoise tunes exist there under the same title and composer
(Ballblazer, Boulder Dash, International Karate, Draconus, Zybex …).
